mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has risen by at least 0.5 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals an emerging recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has increased by more than 0.3pp over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST have increased by at least 0.5% and 5% respectively over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%), rising inflation pressures lead to monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO has increased by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 1.0% signals weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS has fallen by more than 1.0% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a monetary tightening during an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE have increased by at least 0.25pp and 0.1pp respectively over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market booms (HOUST > 1600), a 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates sustained economic strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1600 and HOUST has increased by at least 2.0% over the prior 3 months.
